questions.stem: AI Quantization అంటే ఏమిటి? FP32 Valuesని FP16, INT8, INT4గా Convert చేస్తే Model ఎలా Smaller అవుతుంది?
options: Quantization All Weightsని Plain Text Labelsగా Convert చేస్తుంది.
Quantization Fewer Bitsతో Numerical Model Values Store లేదా Compute చేస్తుంది.
Quantization Precision Same ఉంచి Only Layers Remove చేస్తుంది.
Quantization Predictions Exact Integersగా Change చేసి Rounding Error Eliminate చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Quantization Numbersని Fewer Bitsతో Represent చేస్తుంది. Storage Save అవుతుంది; Slight Rounding Error రావచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. FP32 32-bit Floating, FP16 16-bit Floating. INT8, INT4 Lower-Bit Quantized Representations; Scale, Zero Point, Clippingలో Precision Loss Possible.

questions.stem: Smartphone, Edge AIలో Lower Precision వల్ల RAM, Speed, Battery ఎలా Improve అవుతాయి?
options: Quantized Model Original Training Datasetని Smaller చేసి Every Deviceపై Speed Guarantees చేస్తుంది.
Lower Precision All Mathematical Errors Remove చేసి Accuracy Always Boost చేస్తుంది.
Every CPU, GPU Native INT4 Support చేసి Conversions Never Needs చేస్తుంది.
Smaller Weights Memory Transfers Reduce; Supported Hardwareపై Speed Improve చేయవచ్చు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Smaller Numbers Less RAM Need చేస్తాయి. Chip Support ఉంటే Power, Inference Speed Benefit వస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Quantized Weights/Activations Cache, Memory Bandwidth Save చేయవచ్చు. Unsupported Operators, Conversion Overhead ఉంటే Benefits తగ్గవచ్చు.

questions.stem: 100 Million FP32 Weights INT8, INT4గా Convert చేస్తే Raw Memory ఎంత Change అవుతుంది?
options: FP32 400 MB; INT8 100 MB; Packed INT4 50 MB Approx అవుతుంది.
FP32 100 MB; INT8 400 MB; Packed INT4 800 MB Approx అవుతుంది.
INT8, INT4 Same Bits Use చేస్తాయి; Both Storage Always Identical అంటుంది.
Lower Bits Every Original Value Perfectగా Preserve చేసి Accuracy Never Changes అంటుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: 100 Million Weights: FP32 ~400 MB, INT8 ~100 MB, INT4 ~50 MB. ఇవి Raw Weights Only.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. 100,000,000×4 Bytes=400 Decimal MB; INT8×1=100 MB; Packed INT4×0.5=50 MB. Scale, Padding, Unquantized Layers Extra Memory Need.

questions.stem: Scale, Zero Point, Rounding, Clippingతో Floating Valueని Integerగా ఎలా Convert చేస్తాం? Symmetric, Asymmetric Quantization Difference ఏమిటి?
options: Quantization Valuesని Bit Countతో Multiply చేసి Input Range Completely Ignore చేస్తుంది.
Symmetric Nonzero Zero Point Always Needs; Asymmetric Zero Only Use చేస్తుంది.
Scale, Zero Pointతో Rounded, Clipped Integer Codes Generate చేస్తాం.
Every Float Unique Integerగా Maps; Rounding, Saturation Never Occur అంటుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Float Valueని Small Integer Stepsకి Round చేస్తాం. Range Exceed అయితే Clip చేస్తాం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. q=clamp(round(x/s)+z,min,max), s>0. Dequantize (q−z)s. Symmetric Usually z=0; Asymmetric Offset Zero Point Use చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ), Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)లో Difference ఏంటి? Calibration, Accuracy Trade-offs ఏమిటి?
options: PTQ Complete Retraining Always Needs; QAT Weights Never Updates చేస్తుంది.
PTQ Trained Model Convert; QAT Trainingలో Rounding Simulate చేస్తుంది.
PTQ, QAT Outliers ఏవైనా Exact Same Predictions Always Produce చేస్తాయి.
QAT Calibration Data Need Eliminate చేసి Zero Accuracy Loss Guarantee చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: PTQ Training తర్వాత Compress చేస్తుంది. QAT Trainingలో Precision Lossకి Model Adapt అవుతుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. PTQ Representative Calibration Data Use చేయవచ్చు. QAT Fake Quantization Forwardలో Apply చేసి Student Weights Gradient Updatesతో Adapt చేస్తుంది. Hardware Evaluation Needed.

questions.stem: LLM Quantizationలో GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, Activation Outliers, Mixed Precision ఎలా Handle చేస్తాయి?
options: GPTQ Activations Only Quantize; AWQ Attention Scores Only Adjust చేస్తుంది.
All Techniques Activation Statistics Ignore చేసి Random Rounding Only Use చేస్తాయి.
SmoothQuant Weights Only; AWQ Whole LLM Retrain Mandatory అని Says చేస్తుంది.
GPTQ Weight Error Reduce; AWQ Important Channels Protect; SmoothQuant Outliers Handle చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: GPTQ Weight Error Reduce; AWQ Important Channels Protect; SmoothQuant Activation Outliers Manage చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. GPTQ Approx Second-Order Weight Reconstruction; AWQ Activation Statisticsతో Salient Channels Protect; SmoothQuant Activation Outliersని Weights వైపు Shift చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: CPU, GPU, NPUపై INT8/INT4 Quantization Deploy చేసేటప్పుడు Size, Accuracy, Latency, Energy ఎలా Benchmark చేస్తాం?
options: Target Hardwareపై Inference, Conversion Overhead, Quality, Energy, Latency Measure చేస్తాం.
Smallest Stored Model Every Hardwareపై Fastest, Most Accurate అని Guarantee చేస్తుంది.
INT4 Files Every CPU, GPU, Phoneలో Native INT4 Operators Guarantee చేస్తాయి.
Dequantization Back to Float All Quantization Error Completely Remove చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Smaller Model Speed Guarantee కాదు. Actual Deviceపై Quality, Latency, Battery Check చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Low-Bit Kernel Support, Packing, Dequantization Cost, Memory Bandwidth Device-Specific. End-to-End Latency, Throughput, Accuracy, Energyపై Benchmark చేయాలి.
